children: TOKYO--Japan's Ministry of Finance said Tuesday it is auctioning Y2.5 trillion of five-year government bonds.

Issue                   5-year govt bond (No 18792 reopened) 
Coupon                                                  2.2% 
Settlement Date                                  Sep 9, 2026 
Maturity Date                                   Jun 20, 2031 
Offer Amount                                   Y2.5 Trillion
